===== [p539-539] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 17. Braking Transistor Error (1块) =====
--[p539 [表]]-- 17. Braking Transistor Error
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL-rH3
The regeneration handling transistor built in the servo amplifier is damaged.
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
The braking transistor is short circuited or damaged. | Turn the power off then on again. If the alarm persists, replace the servo amplifier.
Note t . if e braking

===== [p86-86] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 4.3.6 SPC (8块) =====
--[p86]-- SPC | Description
Upon completionof QA process, machine will automatically leave this state.
Engineering | User can manually click in Engineering button to perform Engineering test or evaluationprocess.
No Material | When the machine runs out of material, user may switch the machine to this state manually.
--[p86]-- SPC | Description
In this state,production data and alarm logs will not be recorded.
Planned | User can manually click on Planned button to perform routine maintenances. In this state,production data and alarm logs will not be recorded.
Setup | User can manually click on Setup button to prepare the machine for production of differentpackage. In this state, production data and alarm logs will not be recorded. Machine willautomatically switch to this state during QA (Quality Assurance Process).
--[p86]-- 4.3.6 SPC
Whenever the application starts, the application will automatically start keeping track of the machine states. There are total of 4 different machine states. These 5 states are Idle Time, Unplanned Down Time, Planned Down Time, Setup Time, Engineering Time and No material. Application will automatically track the Operating Time and thus user can’t manually enter Operating Time state through SPC screen.
--[p86 [表]]-- When user wants to enter SPC, click on button on Main Tool bar then following window will be displayed:
SPC | Description
Idle | When machine is idling, it will be switched to this state automatically
Unplanned | When alarm occurs, the application will automatically change the machine state toUnplanned Down Time. When the machine starts to run again, machine state will change toOperating Time. User can also click on unplanned button to troubleshoot errors.

===== [p540-540] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 19. Amplifier Overheat (1块) =====
--[p540 [表]]-- 19. Amplifier Overheat
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL- RH
The temperature of the servo amplifier has exceeded the allowable limit.
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
The ambient temperature exceeds55 [°C]. | Reduce the ambient temperature to 55 [°C] or lower. (40[°C] or lower temperatures are recommended for regularoperation.)
Move heat generating bodies near the servo amplifier asfar away as possible.

===== [p56-56] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 4.2.1 Human Machine Interface (HMI) (2块) =====
--[p56]-- 4.2.1 Human Machine Interface (HMI)
HMI is the primary user interface for both operating, teaching of the machine.
(a) Main menu toolbar - Highlighted on the main menu top of the screen. Toolbars consists of Auto, Setting, Manual, History, User, Login and Exit. Toolbar can be selected by click on the toolbar.
(b) Alarm Display - Error detection generates an appropriate message on the monitor describing the nature of the problem. Refer appendix on error message guide.
--[p56]-- 4.2.1 Human Machine Interface (HMI)
HMI is the primary user interface for both operating, teaching of the machine.
(a) Main menu toolbar - Highlighted on the main menu top of the screen. Toolbars consists of Auto, Setting, Manual, History, User, Login and Exit. Toolbar can be selected by click on the toolbar.
(b) Alarm Display - Error detection generates an appropriate message on the monitor describing the nature of the problem. Refer appendix on error message guide.

===== [p536-536] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 11. Encoder Communication Error (2块) =====
--[p536]-- The encoder cable has a voltage amplitude of about +5 [V], Do not route the encoder cable in a strong magnetic or electric field. Route the encoder cable separately from the main body of the servo amplifier, inverter, electromagnetic contactor or similar (reserve at least 100 [mm]).
--[p536 [表]]-- 11. Encoder Communication Error
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
Communications with the internal encoder of the servomotor fails.
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
Interrupted encoder communications | • Check cables visually and through continuity check and correct faults.
Broken wire or poor contact | • Check for the broken wire in the encoder cable and correct. • Insert ferrite cores.
The servo amplifier and encoder communicate through high speed serial communications.

===== [p535-535] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 7. Memory Error (1块) =====
--[p535 [表]]-- 7. Memory Error
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL- dE
The parameter data stored in the servo amplifier is damaged.
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
Failure of stored data | • Using the PC Loader, read parameters and enter those indicated in red. • Initialize parameters. • Turn the power off then on again. If restoration is not obtained, replace the servo amplifier.
The parameter overwriting frequency has exceeded 100,000 cycles.
| Store the parameters, which need to be overwritten, in the RAM.

===== [p533-533] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 1. Overcurrent (2块) =====
--[p533]-- Cause | Remedy
Short circuit or grounding fault inservomotor output wiring
Servomotor insulation fault | Measure the insulation resistance. (Several MΩ orover to ground)
Failure of servomotor | Measure the resistance across cables. (Several Ωbetween cables)
Incorrect resistance of braking resistor | Replace with the braking resistor within the rating.
Current imbalance caused by an encoderfault | Replace the servomotor.
Unconnected grounding cable | Connect the grounding cable.
--[p533 [表]]-- 1. Overcurrent
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
The output current of the servo amplifier exceeds the rated value.
OC1:Direct detection by internal transistor of servo amplifier
OC2:Indirect detection with software of servo amplifier
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
Wrong servomotor output wiring | • Correct the wiring of power cables (U, V and W).• Check cables visually or through continuity checkand replace the defective cable.

===== [p541-541] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 22. Multi-turn Data Overflow (1块) =====

[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL - AF
Rotation of the output shaft of the servomotor exceeds the range between -32766 and +32765.

===== [p534-534] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 4. Overvoltage (2块) =====
--[p534 [表]]-- 4. Overvoltage
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL- Hu
The DC voltage inside the servo amplifier exceeds the upper limit.
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
The source voltage is too high(immediately after power-on). | • Check if the source voltage is within the specificationlimits.• Insert a reactor if there is a power factor improvementcapacitor.
--[p534]-- Unconnected external brakingresistor or wrong wiring | • Connect the external braking resistor.• Correct the wiring of the external braking resistor.
Broken braking transistor | Replace the servo amplifier.
The internal DC voltage can be checked in the monitor mode of the keypad.
[on\_015]: Internal DC link voltage (max. value)
Approximately over 420 [V], overvoltage is detected.

===== [p537-538] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 14. Main Power Undervoltage (3块) =====
--[p537 [表]]-- 14. Main Power Undervoltage
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL-LUP
The power supplied to the servo amplifier falls below the minimum specification voltage limit.
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
The source voltage drops due tomomentary power failure or similar. | Check the power supply environment whethermomentary power failure is generated or not, andimprove the power supply environment.Check and improve the power supply capacity andtransformer capacity.
--[p538]-- The power is turned on or offintentionally. | Do not turn the power on after the time specified inPA2_68 (main power shutoff detection time) has elapsed.(Detection fails after about 2 [s].)
DC input is under execution. | Set PA2_68 (main power shutoff detection time) at 1000 [ms].
If the power supply environment is adverse, PA2\_67 (alarm detection at undervoltage) can be applied to ignore undervoltage detection.
--[p538]-- In this case, operation can be continued with the setting of PA2\_66 (flying start at speed control) in the event of momentary power failure. Undervoltage detection is set at about 200 [V] by the DC voltage in the servo amplifier.

===== [p92-92] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > -Re-store Alarm (2块) =====

===== [p93-93] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 4.3.9 IO Form (4块) =====
--[p93 [表]]-- 4.3.9 IO Form
Click on IO button on main toolbar, the following window will be displayed. Users can verify the functionality of sensors based on the INPUT signals, as well as triggering OUTPUT to verify module parts (valve etc.)
\*Note: Output triggering function will be turned off if user is currently in Auto Mode.
UPH
Group By Module | Sort IO display based on module
Group By Card | Sort IO display based on card number
--[p93]-- Synchronize Input and Output | Check to display Input and Output together based on same module / cardnumber
Show IO Diagnostic Selection | Show IO trigger chart
Apart from IO verification, the IO form also supports IO signal monitoring chart. To use this function, check the SHOW IO DIAGNOSTIC SELECTION. Then, left click on the IO to monitor, and select which channel to observe. To view the monitoring chart, click on DIAGNOSTIC button. Each monitoring allows up to 4 channels at a same time.

===== [p217-220] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > Step: (8块) =====
--[p218]-- Step:
1. Install “8M W4.0 (S)” alignment jig on 8mm tape track.
2. Loosen 2xM3 cap screws.
3. Align “Sprocket side” sealing shoe (Marked as S1) to alignment jig by adjusting Screw S1.
4. Align “Non-sprocket side” sealing shoe (Marked as S2) to alignment jig by adjusting Screw S2.
5. Tighten back 2xM3 cap screws.
6. Remove alignment jig from tape track.
7. Tape jog to verify sealing shoe alignment.
• How to resolve uneven sealing on cover tape (Sprocket side and non-sprocket side)
--[p220]-- Step:
1. Install sealing shoe leveling jig on the seal press.
2. Turn Off Seal Motor.
3. Loosen 2x M5 cap screws and remove the seal block tension spring.
4. Align seal block until sealing shoe touching to alignment jig. It is to ensure that sealing shoe is parallel to the alignment jig at carrier tape feed direction.
5. Tighten back 2x M5 cap screws.
6. Remove sealing shoe leveling jig.
7. Turn on Seal Motor and install back the spring.
8. Tape jog to verify sealing on cover tape.
--[p217]-- Step:
1. Loosen 8x screws. (screw size depending on tape track type)
2. Move track cover upwards and downwards to align cover tape to carrier tape. Cover tape MUST not exceed carrier tape’s sprocket holes.
3. Tighten back 8x screws.
4. Tape jog to verify cover tape alignment.
How to resolve sealing shoe shifted to carrier tape problem
--[p219]-- Step:
1. Install sealing shoe leveling jig on the seal press.
2. Turn Off Seal Motor.
3. Loosen 2x M5 cap screws and remove the seal block tension spring.
4. Slowly adjust 2 screws (X&Y) once Sealing Shoe touching to alignment jig. It is to ensure that both sealing shoe is parallel to the alignment jig.
5. Tighten back 2x M5 cap screws.
6. Remove sealing shoe leveling jig.
7. Turn on Seal Motor and install back the spring.
8. Tape jog to verify sealing on cover tape.
• How to resolve sealing shoe uneven sealing on cover tape (Carrier tape feed direction)
--[p220]-- Step:
1. Install sealing shoe leveling jig on the seal press.
2. Turn Off Seal Motor.
3. Loosen 2x M5 cap screws and remove the seal block tension spring.
4. Align seal block until sealing shoe touching to alignment jig. It is to ensure that sealing shoe is parallel to the alignment jig at carrier tape feed direction.
5. Tighten back 2x M5 cap screws.
6. Remove sealing shoe leveling jig.
7. Turn on Seal Motor and install back the spring.
8. Tape jog to verify sealing on cover tape.
--[p217]-- Step:
1. Loosen 8x screws. (screw size depending on tape track type)
2. Move track cover upwards and downwards to align cover tape to carrier tape. Cover tape MUST not exceed carrier tape’s sprocket holes.
3. Tighten back 8x screws.
4. Tape jog to verify cover tape alignment.

6) Select the suitable transition choice (5) for measurement the crosshair. The recommended transition choice is “Largest Amplitude”.
7) Select the suitable threshold (6) for measurement the crosshair. The recommended threshold is from 10 to 40.

===== [p7-7] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 1.3 General Precautions (4块) =====
--[p7]-- e) Standard precautions related to live electrical circuits must be taken at all times when adjusting or servicing the equipment.
f) Never rest tools or materials on the machine during servicing.
g) Observe the manufacturer's recommended safety precautions when handling and using chemical substances.
--[p7]-- 1.3 General Precautions
The following safety precautions should be observed whenever operating, adjusting, or servicing this equipment.
a) Observe all WARNING, CAUTIONS, and DANGER labels noted in the text of the technical publications.
b) Always disable all motors before putting hands near powered systems.
c) Always operate the machine with all guards in place.
d) Keep hands clear of the area while the machine is operating.
--[p7]-- 1.3 General Precautions

===== [p534-534] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 5. Encoder Trouble (1块) =====
--[p534 [表]]-- 5. Encoder Trouble
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL-EEI
There is a fault in the encoder built in the servomotor.
(Communications are normal.)
AL-EE2
• Et1: Single revolution position detection fault of encoder
• Et2: Encoder memory data reading fault
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
Fault in data sent from encoder | Use shielded cables to eliminate noise effects.
Failure of encoder | Replace the servomotor.

===== [p274-275] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > Cover Tape Guide (6块) =====
--[p275]-- Use air gun to blow the fitting and vacuum port of the tape track.
After removing the tape track, remove all the vacuum tubing (blue) to the tape and reel.
Use air gun to blow into the fittings of the vacuum port of the Tape & Reel module.
Install back the tubing after the cleaning is done.
Check and make sure the Carrier Coupling is in good condition.
Coupling have to change if found any worn out.
--[p274]-- Cover Tape Guide
The cover tape guide can be remove with or without removing the tape track.
Turn the shaft holder 90 degree counter clockwise direction.
Before pull the shaft out from the cover tape guide, hold the cover tape guide spring loaded section to prevent the spring from falling out.
Pull the shaft out and clean the cover tape guide.
Clean both surface which have contact with cover tape
Install back the cover tape guide after the cleaning is done.
--[p275]-- Remove the seal press from the Tape & Reel Module.
Remove the seal cover and use clean cloth with IPA to clean the surface of seal press and seal cover which contact to carrier tape and cover tape.
Use air gun to blow the fitting and vacuum path of the seal press.
Remove the tape track from the Tape & Reel Module.
Remove the track cover and use clean cloth with IPA to clean the surface of tape track and track cover which contact to carrier tape.

--[p538 [表]]-- 15. Internal Braking Resistor Overheat
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
The power consumption of the braking resistor built in the servo amplifier exceeds the upper limit. (Detection is made at the internal electronic thermal relay of the servo amplifier.)
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
Excessive source voltage (immediately after power-on) | Check if the source voltage is within specification limits. | Insert a reactor if there is a power factor improvement capacitor.

===== [p6-6] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > Precautions (2块) =====
--[p6]-- Precautions
(a) Observe all Warnings and Cautions information.
(b) Always disable all motors before putting hands near movable parts as X, Y table, Z axis, (input/output), Elevator and other powered systems.
(c) Keep hands clear from moving parts area while machine is operating.
(d) Operate the machine with covers installed all the time.
(e) Never leave material on the machine while under servicing.
--[p6]-- Precautions
(a) Observe all Warnings and Cautions information.
(b) Always disable all motors before putting hands near movable parts as X, Y table, Z axis, (input/output), Elevator and other powered systems.
(c) Keep hands clear from moving parts area while machine is operating.
(d) Operate the machine with covers installed all the time.
(e) Never leave material on the machine while under servicing.

The acceleration/deceleration frequencyand operation frequency are too high. | Increase the cycle time and decrease theoperation frequency.
Servo amplifier is damaged. | Replace the servo amplifier.
--[p537 [表]]-- 13. Overload
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL-OL1
• OL1: Instantaneous alarm such as a locked shaft. (3s/300%)
$$
\boxed { 1 + 1 - \cot - 5 }
$$
• OL2: The effective torque exceeds the allowable limit of the servomotor. (Detection at electronic thermal relay built in servo amplifier) (About 200s/200%)
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
The servomotor fails to rotatemechanically. | Check the wiring of power cables (U, V andW) and correct faults.Check if the brake is active.
--[p537]-- If an OL2 alarm is caused but no damaged servo amplifier or incorrect wiring is found, the servomotor capacity must be examined.
Check the OL thermal value with the PC Loader or monitor mode of the keypad in both cases.

===== [p60-61] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > (a) To Enter User Admin (6块) =====
--[p60]-- (a) To Enter User Admin
To enter User Admin, just click on User
button on main toolbar, the following window will be displayed.
User Admin is a utility used to manage users, groups and users right. Users must gain the access level in order to add a new user and to modify user right. All users must be assigning to become member of the one of the 4 groups.
These 4 groups are:
i. Administration
ii. DPE Vendor
iii. Engineer
iv. Operator
v. Technician
--[p61]-- Enter a new user full name and password then click on save button. User can only modify the user group to the same or lower user group. If these user properties do not belong to this user, then this user won’t be able to modify the password. Only individual concern is allowed to modify his owns password.
--[p60]-- Different group have different access level, Administrator will have the highest access level, followed by DPE Vendor, Engineer, Technician and lastly Operator. There is 4-default user, which are dpe, Eng, OP and vendor.
Click on Close button on User Manager to exit User Admin.
(b) To Change User Full Name and Password
Double click on the User Profile dialog box will be displayed:
button on User Manager Window page; the following “User profile”

===== [p542-542] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 24. Command Pulse Frequency Error (1块) =====
--[p542 [表]]-- 24. Command Pulse Frequency Error
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
The frequency of the command pulse inside the servo amplifier is high.
200 [MHz] or a higher frequency is detected at the inlet of the position deviation counter inside the servo amplifier.
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
The command pulse frequency is high. | Reduce the command pulse frequency.
The pulse reference value such as the inputelectronic gear setting is high.
| Change the pulse ratio setting to a correctreference value.

===== [p6-6] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > Safety labels attached to this system (6块) =====
--[p6]-- Safety labels attached to this system
Personnel must be familiar with all the warning symbols and decals fitted to the machine. Failure to recognize a warning and understand the associated safety instructions may result in injury or death.
Note: Check periodically the existence of safety labels on the equipment. Replace damaged or missing labels immediately.
--[p6]-- 'Danger' is advice the reader that there is a possibility of death or serious injury. This is indicates an electrical hazard that remains dangerous even after switching off the machine. The machine must be disconnected from the main power supply before any action on parts with this decal on it. 'Danger' is printed in bold, upper/lower case block letters.
--[p6]-- 'Caution' advise the reader that there is a possibility of damage to the facility, system, process program, machine dependent parameters, or product.   
Caution' precedes the procedure to which they apply.
'Warning' advise the reader that there is a possibility of personal injury or death, if sufficient care is not taken when performing a specific procedure. 'Warning' precedes the procedure to which they apply. 'Warnings’ are printed in bold, upper/lower case block letters.

===== [p273-273] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > Sealing Shoes (4块) =====

--[p273]-- Sealing Shoes
\- Remove seal block cover.
Apply some hot iron cleaner paste on a clean cloth and use it to clean the bit of the sealing shoe.
Clean the sealing shoe by rubbing the cloth with paste against the hot sealing shoe bit.
Clean the sealing shoe again with the cloth without the paste to remove excessive paste.
Check the sealing shoe with the mirror after the cleaning to make sure the sealing shoe is clean.
Check the sealing shoe bit for dented of damage as well.
--[p273]-- Sealing Shoes
\- Remove seal block cover.
Apply some hot iron cleaner paste on a clean cloth and use it to clean the bit of the sealing shoe.
Clean the sealing shoe by rubbing the cloth with paste against the hot sealing shoe bit.
Clean the sealing shoe again with the cloth without the paste to remove excessive paste.
Check the sealing shoe with the mirror after the cleaning to make sure the sealing shoe is clean.
Check the sealing shoe bit for dented of damage as well.
--[p273]-- (if the sealing shoe is damage, it need to be replace with a new one to ensure good sealing quality)

===== [p56-56] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 4.1.1 Power up Procedure (4块) =====
--[p56]-- Any failure or alarm detected during the process will be displayed on the screen. Upon completion of the auto-homing process, user will be able to login to the system proceed to production.
--[p56]-- 4.1.1 Power up Procedure
i. Turn On main switch at the left-hand side of machine.
ii. Release all EMO buttons.
iii. Press Power button at front of machine.
iv. Power ON UPS (Uninterrupted Power System) for all the computers (Industrial PC).
v. Enter MiEquipment.exe application.
vi. Wait for the machine to complete auto homing process.
vii. Login to system.
viii. Enter Auto Mode.
The entire power-up sequence takes about 3 to 5 minutes to complete.
--[p56]-- 4.1.1 Power up Procedure
i. Turn On main switch at the left-hand side of machine.
ii. Release all EMO buttons.
iii. Press Power button at front of machine.
iv. Power ON UPS (Uninterrupted Power System) for all the computers (Industrial PC).
v. Enter MiEquipment.exe application.
vi. Wait for the machine to complete auto homing process.
vii. Login to system.
viii. Enter Auto Mode.
The entire power-up sequence takes about 3 to 5 minutes to complete.
--[p56]-- Any failure or alarm detected during the process will be displayed on the screen. Upon completion of the auto-homing process, user will be able to login to the system proceed to production.

===== [p277-277] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > Cleaning the Emitter Points (2块) =====
--[p277]-- Cleaning the Emitter Points
Turn off the unit. Normally, the emitter points can be cleaned by using air gun to blow off any dirt that may have accumulated on them. A swab moistened with the IPA solution may be used if required. If using a swab, gently wipe the tips of the emitter points until all the dirt is removed.
Wire emitter points should not be bent or moved during cleaning. After cleaning make sure that the emitter wire point to the center of the fan and are on the same horizontal plane.
The Blower uses internally-shielded emitter points that will not normally require replacement during its service life.
--[p277]-- Cleaning the Emitter Points
Turn off the unit. Normally, the emitter points can be cleaned by using air gun to blow off any dirt that may have accumulated on them. A swab moistened with the IPA solution may be used if required. If using a swab, gently wipe the tips of the emitter points until all the dirt is removed.
Wire emitter points should not be bent or moved during cleaning. After cleaning make sure that the emitter wire point to the center of the fan and are on the same horizontal plane.
The Blower uses internally-shielded emitter points that will not normally require replacement during its service life.

===== [p539-539] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 18. Deviation Overflow (3块) =====
--[p539 [表]]-- 18. Deviation Overflow
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL - oF
A position deviation amount equivalent to servomotor revolutions specified in PA2 69 (deviation detection overflow value) is accumulated inside the servo amplifier.
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
Wrong connection of power cables(The alarm is alerted immediately whenservo-on is turned on.) | Check and correct the wiring of power cables (U, Vand W).
The servomotor fails to rotate mechanically.
--[p539]-- The default setting of PA2 69 (deviation detection overflow value) is 15 (rev), that is, 20 bits x 15 pulses. During regular servo system operation, the deviation amount increases in proportion to the rotation speed.
--[p539]-- Cause | Remedy
| Check if the brake is applied.
Low output torque | Increase PA1_27, _28 (torque limit).
The deviation detection width is small. | Increase PA2_69 (deviation detection overflowvalue).
The amplifier is in the P control mode. | Turn off the P motion signal.
Low gain | Perform gain adjustment.
Acceleration/deceleration of pulse trainfrequency is too acute. | Increase the acceleration/deceleration time.

The effective torque exceeds the rating. | Increase the cycle time and reduce the operation frequency.

===== [p8-8] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 2.1.2 Scope (2块) =====
--[p8]-- 2.1.2 Scope
This section provides a brief overview of the machine major subsystems. The Mi30 Automatic Die Tape and Reel platform is designed to transfer semiconductor (ID) from a full capacity die wafer to tape and reel form. The machine also features an integrated vision system, automatic material handling systems, and open short test systems.
--[p8]-- 2.1.2 Scope
This section provides a brief overview of the machine major subsystems. The Mi30 Automatic Die Tape and Reel platform is designed to transfer semiconductor (ID) from a full capacity die wafer to tape and reel form. The machine also features an integrated vision system, automatic material handling systems, and open short test systems.

===== [p216-216] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > (B)Poor Sealing Quality (2块) =====
--[p216]-- (B)Poor Sealing Quality
• Cover tape exceeds carrier tape’s sprocket holes.
• Sealing shoe shifted to carrier tape.
• Not even sealing on cover tape (Sprocket side and non sprocket side).
• Not even sealing on cover tape (Carrier tape feed direction).
• Cover tape Over-press (Sealing shoe seal position is too low)

• Not even sealing on cover tape (Carrier tape feed direction).

--[p263]-- Tip Holder Cleaning

===== [p56-56] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 4.1.2 Power down Procedure (2块) =====
--[p56]-- 4.1.2 Power down Procedure
i. Remove any wafer or material from the machine.
ii. Select Exit in Production or Engineering mode to exit from Auto Mode.
iii. Select Exit from the menu to close the application. All motors will be turned off upon exit
iv. From monitor screen menu, select Start and opt for shut down
v. Press EMO button to power-off machine
vi. Turn Off main switch at side of machine
Caution: Turning off the machine without proper shut down procedure may damage the computer hard disk!
--[p56]-- 4.1.2 Power down Procedure

===== [p536-536] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > 10. Braking Transistor Overheat (1块) =====
--[p536 [表]]-- 10. Braking Transistor Overheat
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL-EH
The regeneration handling transistor built in the servo amplifier is overheated.
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
High source voltage (immediately after power-on) | • Check if the source voltage is within the specification limits. • Insert a reactor if there is a power factor improvement capacitor.
Too large regeneration power | • Increase the deceleration time. • Decrease the servomotor rotation speed.
• Increase the dwell and decrease the regeneration frequency.

===== [p322-322] Mi30 MACHINE USER MANUAL > Estimated Root Cause Action (4块) =====
--[p322]-- Estimated Root Cause Action
Incoming vacuum low Check vacuum pump gauge value.
Leakage Check tubing connection and replace if necessary.
Fitting loosen Check fitting installation and re-tighten or replace if necessary.
Wrong parameter setting Check the parameter and reset to -33.0kPa if necessary.
Disconnection to handler Check the connection to vacuum switch.
--[p322]-- Estimated Root Cause Action
Incoming pressure low Check pressure pump gauge value.
Air leakage Check tubing connection and replace if necessary.
Fitting loosen Check fitting installation and re-tighten or replace if necessary.
Wrong parameter setting Check the parameter and reset to 0.4 Bar if necessary.
Disconnection to handler Check the connection to pressure switch.

===== [p37-38] 14. Main Power Undervoltage (3块) =====
--[p37 [表]]-- 14. Main Power Undervoltage
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL-LUP
The power supplied to the servo amplifier falls below the minimum specification voltage limit.
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
The source voltage drops due tomomentary power failure or similar. | Check the power supply environment whethermomentary power failure is generated or not, andimprove the power supply environment.Check and improve the power supply capacity andtransformer capacity.
--[p38]-- The power is turned on or offintentionally. | Do not turn the power on after the time specified inPA2_68 (main power shutoff detection time) has elapsed.(Detection fails after about 2 [s].)
DC input is under execution. | Set PA2_68 (main power shutoff detection time) at 1000 [ms].
If the power supply environment is adverse, PA2\_67 (alarm detection at undervoltage) can be applied to ignore undervoltage detection.
--[p38]-- In this case, operation can be continued with the setting of PA2\_66 (flying start at speed control) in the event of momentary power failure. Undervoltage detection is set at about 200 [V] by the DC voltage in the servo amplifier.

===== [p36-36] 11. Encoder Communication Error (2块) =====

[Description of detected alarm]

[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
Interrupted encoder communications | • Check cables visually and through continuity check and correct faults.
Broken wire or poor contact | • Check for the broken wire in the encoder cable and correct. • Insert ferrite cores.
The servo amplifier and encoder communicate through high speed serial communications.
--[p36]-- The encoder cable has a voltage amplitude of about +5 [V], Do not route the encoder cable in a strong magnetic or electric field. Route the encoder cable separately from the main body of the servo amplifier, inverter, electromagnetic contactor or similar (reserve at least 100 [mm]).

===== [p39-39] 18. Deviation Overflow (3块) =====
--[p39 [表]]-- 18. Deviation Overflow
[Display]
[Description of detected alarm]
AL - oF
A position deviation amount equivalent to servomotor revolutions specified in PA2 69 (deviation detection overflow value) is accumulated inside the servo amplifier.
[Cause and remedy]
Cause | Remedy
Wrong connection of power cables(The alarm is alerted immediately whenservo-on is tumed on.) | Check and correct the wiring of power cables (U, Vand W).
The servomotor fails to rotate mechanically.
--[p39]-- The default setting of PA2 69 (deviation detection overflow value) is 15 (rev), that is, 20 bits x 15 pulses. During regular servo system operation, the deviation amount increases in proportion to the rotation speed.
--[p39]-- Cause | Remedy
| Check if the brake is applied.
Low output torque | Increase PA1_27, _28 (torque limit).
The deviation detection width is small. | Increase PA2_69 (deviation detection overflowvalue).
The amplifier is in the P control mode. | Turn off the P motion signal.
Low gain | Perform gain adjustment.
Acceleration/deceleration of pulse trainfrequency is too acute. | Increase the acceleration/deceleration time.

Failure of servomotor | Measure the resistance across cables. (Several Ωbetween cables)

Current imbalance caused by an encoderfault | Replace the servomotor.
